name: Veridian Optics Micro-Surgery Exo-Gloves
description:
Precision exoskeletal gloves that stabilize hand tremor and amplify fine motor control by a factor of twenty. Micro-actuators along each finger cancel involuntary movement while translating the wearer's intended motions into ultra-precise mechanical action. The gloves are bulkier than standard surgical equipment but enable a level of dexterity that even augmented hands cannot match.

Used for microsurgery, nano-scale assembly, and the kind of augmentation installation work where a slip of 0.1mm means the difference between success and permanent nerve damage.
functionality: 20x fine motor amplification, tremor cancellation, sub-millimeter precision
what_it_says: Your hands perform at a scale where human imprecision is unacceptable, so you've removed it.
story_hooks: A micro-surgery exo-glove is found in a pawnshop with its precision log still intact — the last operation recorded was performed on something with a cellular structure that doesn't match any known organism.
